text:
Evan: ALERT — GPU queue > 120 pods pending in eu-west-1. Autoscaler keeps requesting nodes but new instances are stuck in Pending (Provisioning). Seeing a bunch of pods with "FailedCreatePodSandBox: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = failed to allocate IP"

Sophia: confirming, dashboards show spike at 11:40 UTC. autoscaler events: `ScaleUp: will try to add 24 nodes` then cloud provider returns ENI/IP allocation errors.

Raj: checking VPC subnet free IPs — looks like subnet-a has 0 available addresses. Many recent replica sets for long-running training jobs landed with hostNetwork:false and need secondary IPs.

Maya: @Raj can you paste `kubectl describe pod` for one of the pending pods?

Raj: pasted: ```
Events:
  Type     Reason            Age   From               Message
  ----     ------            ----  ----               -------
  Normal   Scheduled         5m    default-scheduler  Successfully assigned workspace/gpu-train-34 to ip-10-0-2-45.ec2.internal
  Warning  FailedCreatePodSandBox 3m   kubelet            failed to create pod sandbox: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = failed to assign an IP address to container: no available ips in subnet
```

Louise: Ops note — we hit a burst from a scheduled retrain cron across multiple namespaces, each requested GPU 1 per replica, some jobs set `replicas: 10` accidentally. That blew through the subnet's spare IP pool.

k8s-autoscaler-bot: Autoscaler attempted scale from 48 -> 72 nodes. AWS API responses: `NetworkInterfaceLimitExceeded` and `InvalidParameter: Not enough free addresses in the subnet`.

Evan: immediate mitigation proposals: 1) pause/scale down the noisy cron retrains, 2) cordon non-critical GPU nodes to prevent new pods landing, 3) shift some workloads to secondary region (us-east-1) or a different subnet, 4) request subnet expansion / new subnet from infra. Which can we do now?

Maya: I can pause the cron across namespaces. Running `kubectl get cronjob -A | grep retrain` shows 7 jobs. I'll suspend them now.

Raj: suspended, confirmed — new job schedules stopped. But autoscaler still trying to create instances and AWS still rejecting due to ENI limits until cloud calls time out. Current pending pods remain until we free IPs or move them.

Louise: short-term: can we drain a few overloaded nodes and migrate low-priority pods to a different node group that lives in subnet-b? We have a small pool in subnet-b with spare IPs.

Sophia: yes, I can patch the Deployment for low-priority to nodeSelector: subnet=subnet-b and `kubectl rollout restart` where appropriate. Doing in batches to not cause more scaling activity.

ops-bot: Executed action: created taint `gpu.emergency=true:NoSchedule` on nodes in subnet-a to stop new placements.

Evan: Good. Next: longer-term fixes — (A) expand CIDR for subnet-a or create additional GPU subnets, (B) change autoscaler/launch templates to prefer instance types with higher ENI limits (c5n vs g4dn), (C) enforce per-namespace quota on GPUs and IPs to avoid future blasts, (D) update retrain cron to stagger or use queuing.

Raj: I'll open a ticket with cloud infra to request new subnet and ENI quota increase. Also proposing a patch to the autoscaler: add `--max-node-provisioning-retries` and fail faster when ENI limits seen to avoid storm.

Maya: action items recorded: 1) suspend cron retrains (done), 2) cordon + taint subnet-a nodes (done), 3) migrate low-priority workloads to subnet-b (in progress), 4) infra ticket for subnet/ENI (opened), 5) create per-namespace GPU quotas (PR in progress).

Louise: cost note — shifting to larger-instance types for ENI headroom will increase hourly cost but reduces scale-churn. We'll prepare cost comparison for the on-call handoff.

Evan: timeline: aim to have pending queue drained to <20 pods within 40 minutes. If not, escalate to exec on-call for cross-region emergency move.

Sophia: update: after migrations and taints pending pods dropped from 124 -> 18 in 22 minutes. Autoscaler stopped requesting more nodes after cloud API started returning the ENI errors consistently.

Evan: closing loop: we still need infra follow-up + autoscaler tweaks + quotas. Will schedule a postmortem tomorrow 09:30 UTC. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
